correctness.rationale: Acyclic oriented line of acceptable edges yields recurrence w_e=1+sum incoming w_f. Every blocking move adds an edge and deletes only incoming neighbors, strictly increasing integer sum potential. An injection of reachable selected-selected pairs to unavailable unselected-selected pairs proves Phi <= k(n-k) <= floor(n^2/4). Explicit legal right-to-left waves attain equality. The standalone checker confirms all profiles for n=2..11 and construction for n=2..80, without replacing the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A tight bound across all blocking-pair move selections is more demanding than a planner-computed sequence or an individual-participation bound. The exact quadratic total worst case for nearest-neighbor matching sharpens cubic forest estimates, quantifies worst-case renegotiations for a natural path communication network, and the directed-reachability injection explains why path topology is special.
